name: mocha-runs-the-files-its-configuration-and-scripts-name
description: Mocha runs the files of ./test, below it at any depth where its configuration sets recursive, a glob a script hands it, and no file its ignore patterns name or whose name starts with a dot. Each such file is a test file in a JavaScript package with no compiler configuration, so a function only those tests call is reported as test-only use, while a file below the test directory that Mocha does not run is a file nothing loads. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named mocha for the package mocha whose range holds the installed version.
